result.stdout:
pd-readme: keeps a PepperDash Essentials plugin README in sync with its code.

  pd-readme badges   Rewrite the .NET and PepperDash Essentials badges
  pd-readme docs     Regenerate the START/END marker sections under "Plugin Documentation"

Options:
  --project <dir|csproj>       Plugin project (default: current directory). Its *.cs files are the sources.
  --readme <path>              README.md to update (default: <project>/../README.md, then <project>/README.md)
  --check                      Do not write; exit 1 and report an error when the README is stale
  --target-framework <tfm>     badges: overrides TargetFramework read from the .csproj
  --essentials-version <ver>   badges: overrides the PepperDashEssentials PackageReference version read from the .csproj

Exit codes: 0 up to date or updated, 1 stale (--check) or invalid input.
